Mix calibration: 90% original sample + 10% original sample + decoding extension.

:Training a standalone 2 layer FFN to determine top-k at each tree depth
Improvements implemented:
Initialized with bias to favor predicting the max top-k value
Use path probabilities, token probabilities, and entropies at latest layer
Continuous action space of [0, 10] instead of discrete {0, 1, 2,...,10}
Next steps:
Train larger model to obtain upper bound on predictive accuracy
Obtain heuristic-based thresholding baselines (max token/path probability, entropy)
